name: Raheja Imperia
address: Shankar Rao Naram Path, near Peninsula Corporate Park, Lower Parel (marketed as Worli), Mumbai 400013
amenities: Squash, tennis, badminton, basketball and volleyball courts
description: A high-rise luxury residential development by Raheja Universal on Shankar Rao Naram Path, next to Peninsula Corporate Park, in Lower Parel, which portals market as Worli. MahaRERA registered phase Imperia-I in 2017 with a completion date of Dec 2022. Wikipedia's list of Mumbai's tallest buildings gives a 214 m, 52-floor tower completed in 2022. It offers compact-carpet 3 and 4 BHK homes (about 1,400-1,950 sq ft carpet) and larger 5 BHK units, with registered resales averaging about Rs 75,750/sq ft in 2025-26.
notes: Thin sourcing: the WebSearch budget ran out before launch-era news, launch prices or deal reports could be found, so this file rests on Square Yards, RealEstateMumbai and the Wikipedia tallest-buildings list. The launch date is unknown. MahaRERA's original commencement of 22 Aug 2017 is the registration of the ongoing phase, not necessarily the launch. Possession conflict: Square Yards shows 'Ready to Move since Dec 2019' but its FAQ gives Dec 2022 and calls construction 'mid-stage'. Wikipedia lists completion in 2022, and no OC date was found. Towers and floors: MahaRERA phase P51900009379 (Raheja Imperia-I) covers one tower, but registrations reference towers / wings 1, 2, A and B. Floors are 52 (Wikipedia), 54 (RealEstateMumbai), and a registered unit on floor 58 (Square Yards), so towers and floors_max are left out. Units: 459 total, with 262 launched units fully booked by Nov 2025 (Square Yards); the gap suggests more phases or rehab / landowner units. Do not confuse with Raheja Imperia II (The Rivière), a separate current Raheja Universal project in Worli, or with K Raheja Corp, an unrelated company. Computed gross yield: a 3 BHK of 1,447 sq ft carpet asking Rs 3.9 lakh/month, at the registered average of Rs 75,750/sq ft (about Rs 10.96 crore), is about 4.3%. A 4 BHK of 1,950 sq ft at Rs 7.5 lakh/month is about 6.1%. These use asking rents and look high for Worli/Lower Parel.
